description_en: Queries the compliance results of rules in a specified compliance pack within a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内指定合规包中规则的合规结果
name: GetAggregateConfigRuleComplianceByPack

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance pack.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance pack, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

ConfigRuleComplianceResult.description_en: The compliance results of the rules in the compliance pack
ConfigRuleComplianceResult.description_zh: 合规包中规则的合规结果

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance pack

CompliantCount.description_en: The total number of rules for which all evaluation results are Compliant
CompliantCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果全部为合规的规则总数

ConfigRuleCompliances.description_en: A list of rule compliance results

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance result. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The rule is compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The rule is non-compliant.

NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule is not applicable.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available
ComplianceType.description_zh:
合规类型。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据

ConfigRuleId.description_en: The ID of the rule in the compliance pack

ConfigRuleName.description_en: The name of the rule in the compliance pack
ConfigRuleName.example: The bandwidth of the Elastic IP instance meets the minimum requirements.

IgnoredCount.description_en: The total number of rules whose evaluation results include Ignored
IgnoredCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“已忽略”的规则总数

InsufficientDataCount.description_en: The total number of rules whose evaluation results include Insufficient Data
InsufficientDataCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“无数据”的规则总数

NotApplicableCount.description_en: The total number of rules whose evaluation results include Not Applicable
NotApplicableCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“不适用”的规则总数
